::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** [<i>c</i>.1890]  
**Manuscript:** MS New York Public Library, De Coursey Fales Collection/5
:::

My dear [Julian](people/person_1624.qmd)
The photographer finds our lights so very inconvenient that I am going to bring him down to House, & get the benefit of your dark chamber.[^1]  I will come after luncheon - in about 3/4 of an hour

C M Yonge

---

[^1]: A tiny scrap of paper, evidently sent by hand.
[^2]: This note may relate to the photograph of CMY taken by Herbert Rose Barraud (1845-1896)  and published in his *Men and Women of the Day: A Portrait Gallery of Contemporaries* 7 vols (London: Bentley 1888-94).  It evidently dates from before the sale of Otterbourne House which was shortly followed by Julian’s death on 17 October 1891.
